title: Affine Option Pricing with Hawkes-Type Endogenous Jump Activity
summary: We develop a risk-neutral option-pricing model where the activity scale of an infinite-activity jump process is endogenously driven by the asset's own realized price jumps. Jump sizes are governed by a normalized asymmetric tempered-stable Lévy shape, while a predictable activity scale controls the overall jump intensity and is normalized to coincide with the local jump-induced quadratic-variation rate.
